title: Generalization and memorization

summary.definition: 일반화는 보지 못한 입력에도 규칙을 적용하는 능력이고 memorization은 학습 표본을 그대로 기억하는 현상이다.
summary.mechanism: 모델 용량·데이터·정규화·분포 차이가 일반화와 암기의 균형을 바꾼다.
summary.example: 훈련 정확도는 높지만 새로운 업무 데이터에서 급락하면 암기나 분포 이동을 의심한다.

researchEvidence.statement: Research on deep networks treats memorization and generalization as distinguishable behaviors that can coexist; fitting training examples alone is not evidence that a model will perform reliably on unseen data.
researchEvidence.scope: Model generalization, memorization, and evaluation boundary
researchEvidence.invalidation: The cited study is empirical and task-specific; it does not provide a universal test for all architectures, datasets, or deployment settings.

researchEvidence.statement: TSMC describes 3DFabric as a family of 3D silicon stacking and advanced-packaging technologies that integrates logic, memory, and other chiplets at the system level; packaging therefore affects bandwidth, latency, power, form factor, and cost rather than being only a final enclosure step.
researchEvidence.scope: Advanced packaging, heterogeneous integration, chiplets, and system bottlenecks
researchEvidence.invalidation: This is a vendor technology description; customer yield, capacity, pricing, supply availability, and product economics require independent filing and production evidence.

researchEvidence.statement: Micron's HBM2E technical brief describes a wide-interface stacked-memory design whose bandwidth and capacity characteristics differ from conventional graphics memory; system-level bandwidth depends on the memory stack, interface, package, and workload.
researchEvidence.scope: High-bandwidth memory architecture and memory bottlenecks
researchEvidence.invalidation: The cited HBM2E document is product-generation specific; it does not establish current HBM availability, pricing, yield, or performance for later generations.

researchEvidence.statement: The PagedAttention paper models the KV cache as a major and dynamically sized memory component in LLM serving and applies virtual-memory-style paging to reduce fragmentation and improve sharing. It supports a causal link from context and concurrency to memory pressure, not a universal claim that the cache must reside on SSD.
researchEvidence.scope: KV-cache memory management in LLM serving
researchEvidence.invalidation: Reported throughput gains depend on models, hardware, workloads, runtime and baselines; later attention and cache-compression methods can change the bottleneck.
